diagnosis.explanation: Design P003 yields a high G1 improvement (+0.0760) over P015 but incurs a G2 loss (-0.0282). The conflict arises from the positive correlation of layer thickness with reflectance and negative correlation with transmission. Refining layers independently allows for shaping the spectral response to recover transmission in the NIR band without compromising the visible reflection plateau.
